arStrings.szText: {c_important}The Protector{/c} grants an additional {c_number}[{SF_5}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life in {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c}.
{c_important}The Protector's{/c} area deals {c_number}[{SF_21}*100|%x|]{/c} of your Thorns damage to enemies within every {c_number}[{SF_22}|1|]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}The Protector's{/c} area persists for an additional {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} seconds and Slows enemies and Small Missiles by {c_number}[{SF_10}*100|%|]{/c}. While inside, you are {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}The Protector{/c} also deals {c_number}{payload:FOREST_SMASH_B}{/c} damage to enemies around you with each smash. Spend up to {c_number}{SF_29}{/c} stacks of {c_Important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} to increase {c_important}The Protector's{/c} damage by {c_number}[{SF_26}*100|%|]{/c} for each stack spent.

{c_important}The Protector{/c} is also a {c_important}Centipede{/c} Skill. 

The Centipede Spirit aids {c_important}The Protector{/c}, poisoning enemies for {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_C_DOT}{/c} damage each second, {c_important}{u}Weakening{/u}{/c} them, and spawning {c_important}{u}Pestilent Swarms{/u}{/c} that deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage.
